records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Warmly,

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Partners!
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Quartz Partners here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Created first project on day 4 (as_of facts), showing real intent, but no invites, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:19f4cd21], [email:39c4b4e1]) in ~5 days. Starter, solo admin, 8 days left. Silent single-user accounts often stall short of key_milestone, so modestly below even odds.

draft.subject: Next step after your first Quartz Partners project
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team's work.

When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
